answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds lock C opal tokens as collateral for each identity. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix scales penalties quadratically with every forged identity, yielding a strongly negative expected utility for any Sybil multiplication. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces the attacker to expend work before the echo of the bonded stake unlocks rewards, so any coalition that tries to forge extra keys faces a dominated strategy and the unique strict Nash equilibrium is honest participation.
